First release. Convert files from the Explorer right-click menu.

**Install:** run `Henkan-0.0.1-Setup.exe`. If Windows shows "Windows protected your PC", choose **More info** and **Run anyway**.

The `.msix` is for Intune and other deployment tools.

Includes FFmpeg, Ghostscript and 7-Zip ([source code](https://github.com/MyDrift-user/henkan-bundled-tools/releases/tag/tools-2026-09)).
